system.description:
• Necrotic Aura: Always active while you have undead under your control within 30ft.
  • Controlled undead gain +1 damage per hit and +2 HP per Necromancer level
  • Death-effect spells you cast increase the DC of the triggered save by an additional 1

rules.value: Necrotic Aura: death-effect spells you cast have +1 save DC while you control undead within 30ft.
